output.summary: Approve sealed judge calibration runner for independent quality judges.

approvedRows.question: DTR-sealed-judge-calibration
approvedRows.currentState: CodeWiki can optionally inject an independent judge, but there is no sealed calibration runner for human-labeled judge cases.
approvedRows.desiredState: Add a lab runner and npm script that load off-repo sealed judge calibration bundles, call the configured judge, and fail on false passes or low calibration score.
approvedRows.rationale: A judge should not become trusted semantic authority until calibrated against hidden human labels where false pass is the highest-cost error.
approvedRows.userImpact: Users are protected from uncalibrated judge false passes.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers get a repeatable private calibration gate before trusting a judge worker or prompt version.
approvedRows.routeRationale: Small bounded lab tooling addition with targeted tests and no production runtime dependency.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A lab runner loads sealed judge calibration bundles outside the repository and scores judge verdicts against human labels.
Calibration fails when the judge produces false passes on expected fail/block cases.
Docs and scripts explain how to run judge calibration with an off-repo bundle and configured judge endpoint.

approvedRows.recommendationRationale: The change is lab-only calibration tooling, docs, scripts, and tests.

agentAssessment.userAlignment: The user approved proceeding after the sealed-holdout calibration explanation.
agentAssessment.projectBenefit: Closes the judge trust gap without exposing private holdout cases.
agentAssessment.rationale: Calibration separates optional judge provider wiring from evidence that a judge prompt/version is safe.

approvedRows.currentPain: Operators can enable a judge worker without a standard way to verify its prompt/version quality against private cases.
approvedRows.desiredOutcome: Judge prompt/version calibration produces a report with score, false passes, over-blocks, blockers, and gate status.
approvedRows.successSignal: Tests prove off-repo enforcement, passing calibration, false-pass failure, and stable request cache keys.
nonGoals: Do not provide a real model worker.
Do not make judge calibration part of normal deterministic execution.
